advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer The True Behemoth: Tre' Harris + Juwan Johnson for Drake London.
Pick up Tyrone Tracy off waivers (+1.7 points a week) and drop Treylon Burks.

reasons: You're 8-2 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 19%.
A top-2 seed matters: you win the title 32% of the time with the first-round bye and 14% without it. You get the bye in 27% of seasons right now.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 2nd of 8 contenders (184.1 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (10th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 3rd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 3rd in 2028 (title chances about 19%, 19%, 13%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 19% to 21%, and your lineup comes out 1.2 points a week ahead overall. Tre' Harris + Juwan Johnson add 5.9 points a week for you today, but Drake London is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 6,472, get 6,947), though it costs their lineup 1.3 a week, so expect some pushback.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 19% and 13% to 26% and 20%.
You have 8 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Week 6 is your weakest projected week (130 points vs your usual 172), mostly byes.
Cam Skattebo may be worth more now than later: value 4,164 vs ~2,449 for 4.3 pts/wk of production.
